faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about allocation criteria, timelines, and appeals.

items.question: Who is eligible to apply for on-campus hostel housing?
items.answer: All enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students with an active university roll number are eligible. Priority scoring takes into account your year of study, home-to-campus transit distance, and designated academic scholarship criteria.

items.question: How is my roommate questionnaire data protected?
items.answer: Your lifestyle responses (such as sleeping hours, study quietness, and dietary preferences) are strictly private. The matching engine uses mathematical compatibility vectors without revealing individual answers to prospective roommates or unauthorized staff.

items.question: What is a 'Draft allotment' and can it change?
items.answer: A draft allotment is a provisional match generated after the algorithm run. During the 48-hour warden review window, provisional assignments are vetted for special medical cases or maintenance blocks before being published as final.

items.question: How does the appeals process work if I need changes?
items.answer: If you have an urgent medical condition, accessibility accommodation request, or documented conflict, you can submit an online appeal within 72 hours of provisional list publication. Wardens review all tickets with a transparent resolution timestamp.
